logline: After three Israeli teenagers are murdered in 2014, a Shin Bet investigator tracks the Jewish extremists who killed a Palestinian boy in retribution - a true story of atrocity answering atrocity.

bollymeter.basis: 94% on Rotten Tomatoes from 16 critics; Metacritic 79/100. Critics praised its moral unflinching-ness - Daniel D'Addario at Variety wrote it rewards with tough insights into politics and hate. Won 14 Israeli Academy Awards.

pull_quotes.text: Paced with a punishing slowness, but rewards with tough insight into politics and hate.
Easy to watch, which makes it even harder to forget.

seasons.review_body: Created by Hagai Levi, Joseph Cedar, and Tawfik Abu-Wael, Our Boys reconstructs the 2014 murders that briefly pulled the Israeli-Palestinian conflict toward mutual horror from both sides. The series focuses tightly on the Shin Bet investigation into Jewish extremists who killed Mohammed Abu Khdeir in retaliation for the kidnapping of three Israeli teens. Critics at Rotten Tomatoes awarded 94 percent from 16 reviews, with Metacritic scoring 79 out of 100. The pace is deliberately slow - Variety called it punishing - because the series wants its audience to sit with moral discomfort rather than consume it as thriller. The show won 14 Israeli Academy Awards and was nominated for a Peabody. Its commitment to bilingual perspective, following the Abu Khdeir family in Arabic and the investigation in Hebrew, is its structural and moral achievement. The IMDb audience score of 7.8 reflects viewers who met its demands.
